# pushward_org_group (Resource)

A group of organization members. Routing rules and sending keys reach members by group.

`member_ids` takes user ids. A member who was invited by email has none until they join, so build the list with `compact()` over `pushward_org_member.*.user_id`: they are added on the first apply after they join.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pushward_org_group" "oncall" {
  name        = "oncall"
  description = "Gets deploy and incident alerts"

  # People who have not joined yet have no user_id; compact() leaves them out
  # and the next apply after they join adds them.
  member_ids = compact([for m in pushward_org_member.team : m.user_id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique in the organization: 1-40 lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Up to 200 characters.
- `member_ids` (Set of String) User ids of every member of the group. The set replaces the current members; empty by default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pushward_org_group.oncall 5b2e9d14-7c3a-4f8e-a1d6-0e4c8b7f2a93
```
